```yaml
name: Lint Objective-C - Replace [new] with [[alloc] init]

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  push:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  lint-objc-new:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Find and replace [new] with [[alloc] init]
        uses: jacobtomlinson/gha-find-replace@f1069b438f125e5395d84d1c6fd3b559a7880cb5
        with:
          include: "*.m,*.h"
          find: '\[([A-Za-z0-9_]+) new\]'
          replace: '[[$1 alloc] init]'
          regex: true

      - name: Check for changes
        id: check_changes
        run: |
          git diff --exit-code || echo "CHANGES=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Commit changes if any
        if: env.CHANGES == 'true'
        uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
        with:
          message: "chore: replace [new] with [[alloc] init] in ObjC code"
          author_name: "GitHub Actions"
          author_email: "actions@github.com"
          push: true
```
